answer_1.quote: MERGEPRINT embeds fingerprint input-output pairs into the owner model via efficient tuning, ensuring that any merged model derived from the owner model generates the target fingerprint output when queried with the corresponding fingerprint input
answer_1.outputs: fingerprint outputs (e.g., single words like 'transformer' or 'pikachu')
